import arrow
from dateutil import tz as dateutil_tz

# DST spring-forward in US/Pacific: March 12, 2023, 2:00 AM -> 3:00 AM
# Shift from March 11 1:30 AM by 2 hours -> should land in imaginary gap (2:30 AM on March 12)
arw_pacific = arrow.Arrow(2023, 3, 11, 1, 30, tzinfo=dateutil_tz.gettz('US/Pacific'))
print(f"Before shift: {arw_pacific}")

result_default = arw_pacific.shift(hours=2)
result_false = arw_pacific.shift(hours=2, check_imaginary=False)
result_true = arw_pacific.shift(hours=2, check_imaginary=True)

print(f"Default (check_imaginary=True): {result_default}")
print(f"check_imaginary=False: {result_false}")
print(f"check_imaginary=True explicit: {result_true}")
print(f"Default == True: {result_default == result_true}")
print(f"False != Default: {result_false != result_default}")

# Check if the shifted datetime is imaginary
print(f"\nIs default imaginary? {result_default.imaginary}")
print(f"Is false imaginary? {result_false.imaginary}")
